entries.Original:
Opens the Artisan menu.
/artisan lists → Open Lists.
/artisan lists <ID> → Opens specific list by ID.
/artisan lists <ID> start → Starts specific list by ID.
/artisan macros → Open Macros.
/artisan macros <ID> → Opens specific macro by ID.
/artisan endurance → Open Endurance.
/artisan endurance start|stop → Starts or stops endurance mode.
/artisan settings → Open Settings.
/artisan workshops → Open FC Workshops.
/artisan builder → Open List Builder.
/artisan automode → Toggles Automatic Action Execution Mode on/off.
entries.Translated:
打开 Artisan 菜单。
/artisan lists → 打开列表。
/artisan lists <ID> → 按 ID 打开指定列表。
/artisan lists <ID> start → 按 ID 开始指定列表。
/artisan macros → 打开宏。
/artisan macros <ID> → 按 ID 打开指定宏。
/artisan endurance → 打开耐力模式。
/artisan endurance start|stop → 启动或停止耐力模式。
/artisan settings → 打开设置。
/artisan workshops → 打开部队工房。
/artisan builder → 打开列表构建器。
/artisan automode → 切换自动行动执行模式的开关。
创建制作列表（含半成品）（仅星级）
创建制作列表（含半成品）

entries.Original: Create crafting list for this phase (including precrafts)
entries.Translated: 为当前阶段创建制作列表（含半成品）

entries.Original: This tab allows you to quickly assign solvers and consumables to recipes based on recipe criteria.
entries.Translated: 此选项卡允许你根据配方条件快速为配方分配求解器和消耗品。

entries.Original: Show which crafts have been assigned as a notification
entries.Translated: 以通知形式显示已分配的制作

entries.Original: This is a current level master recipe. Your success rate may vary so it is recommended to use an Artisan macro or manually solve this.
entries.Translated: 这是当前等级的大师配方。成功率可能有所不同，因此建议使用 Artisan 宏或手动解决。

Disable that option to set it for each recipe.

entries.Translated: 在增益持续期间，将标准配方求解器切换为专家求解器。

entries.Original:

Disable that option to set it for each recipe.

禁用该选项可为每个配方单独设置。

entries.Original:

To change Raphael solver usage, go to Settings > Raphael Solver Settings.

要更改Raphael求解器用法，请前往设置 > Raphael求解器设置。

entries.Original: . To configure its usage for the Raphael solver, go to Settings > Raphael Solver Settings.

entries.Original: IMPORTANT: These are not advanced settings or "expert user" profiles. They are exclusively for the expert recipe solver.
entries.Translated: 重要：这些不是高级设置或“专家用户”配置。它们仅用于专家配方求解器。

entries.Original: Left click a profile to edit. Right click a profile to select it without editing.
entries.Translated: 左键点击配置进行编辑。右键点击配置可直接选择而不编辑。

entries.Original: If being used more than once, the buff will be immediately re-applied when it runs out.
entries.Translated: 如果使用超过一次，增益效果消失时会立即重新施加。

entries.Translated: 求解器仍只会在适当情况下使用这些技能。

entries.Translated: 专家配方求解器不是标准求解器的替代品。它仅用于专家配方。

entries.Translated: 重要提示：这些设置是为获得最佳性能而选择的。更改它们可能会使求解器明显变差。使用风险自负。
使用专家求解器配置文件

entries.Original: Profiles let you set different expert solver settings for different recipes. This is for advanced users - the expert solver should "just work" for almost everything.
entries.Translated: 配置文件允许你为不同配方设置不同的专家求解器设置。这适用于高级用户——专家求解器几乎对所有情况都"开箱即用"。
创建/编辑专家求解器配置文件

entries.Original: Reset Expert Solver Settings To Default
entries.Translated: 将专家求解器设置重置为默认值

entries.Original: Show only recipes you have materials for (toggle to refresh)
entries.Translated: 仅显示你有材料的配方（切换以刷新）
添加到列表（包含所有子制作）

entries.Original: Adjust all sub-crafts after changing quantities
entries.Translated: 更改数量后调整所有子制作

entries.Original:
This has been reworked! Having this enabled will adjust all quantities in your list rather than just removing unrequired crafts. It will now also add more crafts where required. It will also sort the list afterwards to make sure it's crafting in the right order in case you have removed items.

Quick disclaimer: This will treat whatever item you have selected as a "Final Craft" and only adjust sub-crafts required for that item, and not anything this item may be used for e.g changing lumber won't update crafts that use that lumber.
entries.Translated:
此功能已重做！启用此功能将调整列表中的所有数量，而不仅仅是移除不需要的制作。现在还会在需要时添加更多制作。之后还会对列表进行排序，以确保在移除物品后按正确顺序制作。

快速声明：此功能会将你选择的任何物品视为"最终制作"，并且只调整该物品所需的子制作，而不会调整该物品可能用于的任何其他制作，例如更改木材不会更新使用该木材的制作。

entries.Original: This will sort your list by recipe depth, then difficulty. Recipe depth is defined by how many of the ingredients depend on other recipes on the list.
entries.Translated: 这将按配方深度，然后按难度对列表进行排序。配方深度由列表中有多少材料依赖于其他配方来定义。

entries.Original: , giving this recipe a depth of 3 if all these items are on the list.
entries.Translated: ，如果所有这些物品都在列表中，则此配方的深度为3。

entries.Original: Items that do not have other recipe dependencies have a depth of 1, so go to the top of the list, e.g
entries.Translated: 没有其他配方依赖的物品深度为1，因此位于列表顶部，例如

entries.Original: Finally, this is sorted by the in-game difficulty of the crafts, hopefully grouping together similar crafts.
entries.Translated: 最后，按游戏内制作难度排序，希望将相似制作归为一组。

entries.Original: This will toggle all items in this list between being skipped and being enabled.
entries.Translated: 这将切换列表中所有项目在跳过和启用之间。
正在构建可制作物品列表：

entries.Original: Please add items to your list to populate the ingredients tab.
entries.Translated: 请向列表中添加物品以填充材料选项卡。

entries.Original: Something went wrong creating the table. Try again?
Ingredient table is still populating. Please wait.
entries.Translated: 材料表仍在填充中，请稍候。

entries.Original: For ingredients that can be crafted, this will only show inventory
entries.Translated: 对于可制作的原料，仅显示库存

entries.Original: Export Required Ingredients as Plain Text
entries.Translated: 将所需材料导出为纯文本
所需物品已复制到剪贴板。

entries.Original: No items required to be copied.
Export Remaining Ingredients as Plain Text
entries.Translated: 将剩余材料导出为纯文本
剩余物品已复制到剪贴板。

entries.Original: No items remaining to be copied.
Hold shift to change from remaining to required.
entries.Translated: 按住Shift可从剩余切换为所需。
- 库存拥有所有所需物品

entries.Original: or is not required due to owning crafted materials using this ingredient
entries.Translated: 或由于拥有使用此原料制作的材料而不需要

entries.Original: - Combination of Retainer & Inventory has all required items
entries.Translated: - 雇员与库存组合拥有所有所需物品

entries.Original: - Combination of Inventory & Craftable has all required items.
entries.Translated: - 库存与可制作组合拥有所有所需物品。

entries.Original: This ingredients table shows you everything needed to craft the items on your list. The basic functionality of the table shows you information such as how many of an ingredient is in your inventory, sources of an ingredient, if it has a zone it can be gathered in etc.
entries.Translated: 此材料表显示制作列表中物品所需的一切。表格的基本功能显示诸如库存中有多少原料、原料来源、是否有可采集区域等信息。

entries.Original: You can click on the column headers to filter the results, either through typing or on a pre-determined filter.
entries.Translated: 您可以点击列标题来筛选结果，可通过输入或预设筛选条件。

entries.Original: Right clicking on a header will allow you to show/hide different columns or resize columns.
entries.Translated: 右键点击标题可显示/隐藏不同列或调整列宽。

entries.Original: Right clicking on an ingredient name opens a context menu with further options.
entries.Translated: 右键点击原料名称可打开包含更多选项的上下文菜单。

entries.Original: Clicking and dragging on the space on the headers between columns (as shown by it lighting up) allows you to re-order the columns.
entries.Translated: 点击并拖动列之间的表头区域（如高亮所示）可重新排序列。

entries.Original: Don't see any items? Check the table headers for a red heading. This indicates this column is being filtered on. Right clicking the header will clear the filter.
entries.Translated: 看不到物品？检查表头是否有红色标题。这表示该列正在被筛选。右键点击表头可清除筛选。

entries.Original:
You can extend the functionality of the table by installing the following plugins:
- Allagan Tools (Enables all retainer features)
- Item Vendor Lookup
- Gatherbuddy
- Monster Loot Hunter
entries.Translated:
你可以通过安装以下插件来扩展表格功能：
- Allagan Tools（启用所有雇员功能）
- Item Vendor Lookup
- Gatherbuddy
- Monster Loot Hunter

entries.Original:
Tip: Filter on "Remaining Needed" and "Sources" when gathering to help filter on items missing, along with sorting by gathered zone
to help reduce travel times.
entries.Translated:
提示：采集时筛选“剩余所需”和“来源”，并按采集区域排序，有助于筛选缺失物品，
减少跑图时间。

entries.Original: Will skip crafting any unnecessary materials required for your list.
entries.Translated: 将跳过制作清单所需的任何非必要材料。

entries.Original:
Will continue to craft materials whilst your inventory has less of a material up to the amount the list would craft if starting from zero.

[Recipe Amount Result] x [Number of Crafts] is less than [Inventory Amount].

Use this when crafting materials for items not on your list (eg FC workshop projects)

This will also adjust the ingredient table's remaining column and colour validation to exclude checking for crafted items the ingredient may be used in.
entries.Translated:
当你的背包中某种材料数量低于清单从零开始制作时的数量时，将继续制作该材料。

[配方数量结果] x [制作次数] 小于 [背包数量]。

当为清单外的物品制作材料时使用此选项（例如部队工房项目）。

这也会调整材料表的剩余列和颜色校验，以排除对材料可能用于制作的物品的检查。

entries.Original: This character has not unlocked materia extraction. This setting will be ignored.
entries.Translated: 该角色尚未解锁精制魔晶石。此设置将被忽略。

entries.Original: Will automatically extract materia from any equipped gear once it's spiritbond is 100%
entries.Translated: 当任意已装备装备的魂晶共鸣度达到100%时，将自动精制魔晶石。

entries.Original:
If enabled, Artisan will automatically repair your gear when any piece reaches the configured repair threshold.

当前最低装备耐久度为

gil.

金币。

如果无法使用暗物质修理，将尝试寻找附近的修理 NPC。

entries.Original: Set new items added to list as quick synth
entries.Translated: 将添加到清单的新物品设为快速合成

entries.Original: Quick Synth applied to all list items.
entries.Translated: 快速合成已应用到所有清单物品。

entries.Original: You do not have quick synth consumables enabled. Turn this on?
entries.Translated: 你尚未启用快速合成消耗品。要启用吗？

entries.Original: This item cannot be quick synthed.

Shows the crafting requirements: Progress needed to complete the craft, how much Durability the recipe has, and Quality target required to reach the highest Quality level (In case of a Collectible). Use this information to select an appropriate macro, if desired.
entries.Translated: 显示制作要求：完成制作所需的进度、配方的耐久度，以及达到最高品质等级所需的品质目标（如果是收藏品）。使用此信息选择合适的宏（如果需要）。
假设最大初始品质（用于模拟器）

entries.Original: Please run this recipe in the simulator for results.
entries.Translated: 请在模拟器中运行此配方以查看结果。

entries.Original: Please install Allagan Tools for retainer features.
entries.Translated: 请安装 Allagan Tools 以使用雇员功能。

entries.Original: Please enable Allagan Tools for retainer features.
entries.Translated: 请启用 Allagan Tools 以使用雇员功能。

entries.Original: You have turned off Allagan Tools integration.
entries.Translated: 您已关闭 Allagan Tools 集成。

entries.Original: Once you're at 100% quality, the macro will skip over all actions relating to quality, including buffs.
entries.Translated: 当品质达到100%时，宏将跳过所有与品质相关的动作，包括增益。

entries.Original: If you get a Good or Excellent condition and your macro is on a step that increases quality (not including Byregot's Blessing) then it will upgrade the action to Precise Touch.
entries.Translated: 如果出现良好或卓越状态，且宏当前步骤为增加品质（不包括比尔格的天之恩典），则将该动作升级为精密加工。

entries.Original: If you get a Good or Excellent condition and your macro is on a step that increases progress then it will upgrade the action to Intensive Synthesis.
entries.Translated: 如果出现良好或卓越状态，且宏当前步骤为增加进度，则将该动作升级为精密制作。

entries.Original: Artisan will not start crafting if you do not meet this minimum craftsmanship with this macro selected.
entries.Translated: 若未达到此最低作业精度，Artisan 将不会开始制作。

entries.Original: Artisan will not start crafting if you do not meet this minimum control with this macro selected.
entries.Translated: 若未达到此最低加工精度，Artisan 将不会开始制作。

entries.Original: Artisan will not start crafting if you do not meet this minimum CP with this macro selected.
entries.Translated: 若未达到此最低CP，Artisan 将不会开始制作。

entries.Original: Insert New Action - Same As Previous (
entries.Translated: 插入新动作 - 与上一个相同(

entries.Original: Uses a recommendation from the appropriate default solver, i.e Standard Recipe Solver for regular recipes, Expert Recipe Solver for expert recipes.
entries.Translated: 使用相应默认求解器的建议，即常规配方使用标准配方求解器，专家配方使用专家配方求解器。

entries.Original: This will use the appropriate step of the 3-step touch combo, depending on the last action actually used. Useful if upgrading quality actions or skipping on conditions.
entries.Translated: 将根据实际使用的上一个动作，使用三步加工连击中的相应步骤。在升级品质动作或按条件跳过时很有用。

entries.Original: Similar to the other touch combo, this will alternate between Basic Touch & Refined Touch depending on the previous action used.
entries.Translated: 与其他加工连击类似，将根据之前使用的动作在“加工”和“精加工”之间交替。

entries.Original:
You can either copy/paste macros directly as you would a normal game macro, or list each action on its own per line.
For example:
/ac Muscle Memory

is the same as

Muscle Memory

You can also use * (asterisk) or 'Artisan Recommendation' to insert Artisan's recommendation as a step.
entries.Translated:
您可以直接复制/粘贴宏，就像普通游戏宏一样，也可以每行列出每个动作。
例如：
/ac 坚信

等同于

坚信

您还可以使用 *（星号）或“Artisan 推荐”来插入 Artisan 的推荐作为一步。

entries.Original: This tab will allow you to add macros that Artisan can use instead of its own decisions. Once you create a new macro, click on it from the list below to open up the macro editor window for your macro.
entries.Translated: 此选项卡允许您添加 Artisan 可以使用的宏，以替代其自身的决策。创建新宏后，从下方列表中单击它即可打开该宏的宏编辑器窗口。

entries.Original: Crafting in progress. Macro settings will be unavailable until you stop crafting.
entries.Translated: 制作进行中。在停止制作之前，宏设置将不可用。
从剪贴板导入宏（Artisan 导出）

entries.Original: Reorder Mode (Click and Drag to Reorder)
entries.Translated: 重新排序模式（单击并拖动以重新排序）

entries.Original: Listen buddy, you're on Dalamud staging, there's every chance any problems you might encounter is specific to Dalamud's testing and not Artisan. I don't make this plugin to work on staging, so don't expect any fixes unless the problem makes it to Dalamud release.
entries.Translated: 听着，朋友，你用的是 Dalamud 测试版，你遇到的任何问题都很有可能是 Dalamud 测试特有的，而不是 Artisan 的问题。我制作这个插件并不是为了在测试版上运行，所以除非问题出现在 Dalamud 正式版中，否则别指望修复。

entries.Original: I would first like to thank you for downloading my little crafting plugin. I have been working on Artisan consistently since June 2022 and it's my magnum opus of a plugin.
entries.Translated: 首先感谢您下载我的这个小制作插件。自2022年6月以来，我一直在持续开发Artisan，它是我引以为傲的插件作品。

entries.Original: Before you get started with Artisan, we should go over a few things about how the plugin works. Artisan is simple to use once you understand a few key factors.
entries.Translated: 在开始使用Artisan之前，我们需要了解一些关于插件工作原理的事项。一旦您理解了几个关键因素，Artisan就很容易使用。

entries.Original: Artisan features an "Automatic Action Execution Mode" which merely takes the suggestions provided to it and performs the action on your behalf. By default, this will fire as fast as the game allows, which is faster than normal macros. You are not bypassing any sort of game restrictions doing this, however you can set a delay should you choose to. Enabling this has nothing to do with the suggestion making process Artisan uses by default.
entries.Translated: Artisan具有“自动执行动作模式”，它仅获取提供的建议并代表您执行动作。默认情况下，它会以游戏允许的最快速度触发，比普通宏更快。这样做并不会绕过任何游戏限制，但您也可以根据需要设置延迟。启用此功能与Artisan默认使用的建议生成过程无关。

entries.Original: If you do not have the automatic mode enabled, you will have access to 2 more modes. "Semi-Manual Mode" and "Full Manual". "Semi-Manual Mode" will appear in a small pop-up window when you start crafting.
entries.Translated: 如果您未启用自动模式，您将可以使用另外两种模式：“半手动模式”和“全手动模式”。“半手动模式”会在您开始制作时显示在一个小弹出窗口中。

entries.Original: By clicking the "Execute recommended action" button, you are instructing the plugin to perform the suggestion it has recommended. This considered semi-manual as you still have to click each action, but you don't have to worry about finding them on your hotbars. "Full-Manual" mode is performed by pressing the buttons on your hotbar as normal. You are provided with an aid by default as Artisan will highlight the action on your hotbar if it is slotted. (This can be disabled in the settings)
entries.Translated: 通过点击“执行推荐动作”按钮，您指示插件执行其推荐的建议。这被视为半手动，因为您仍然需要点击每个动作，但您不必担心在热键栏上找到它们。“全手动”模式是通过正常按下热键栏上的按钮来执行的。默认情况下，您会获得辅助，因为Artisan会在热键栏上高亮显示该动作（如果已放置）。（这可以在设置中禁用）

entries.Original:
Artisan by default will provide you with suggestions on what your next crafting step should be. This solver is not perfect however and it is definitely not a substitute for having appropriate gear. You do not need to do anything to enable this behaviour other than have Artisan enabled. 

If you are trying to tackle a craft that the default solver cannot craft, Artisan allows you to build macros which can be used as the suggestions instead of the default solver. Artisan macros have the benefit of not being restricted in length, can fire off as fast as the game allows and also allows some additional options to tweak on the fly.
entries.Translated:
Artisan默认会为您提供下一步制作步骤的建议。然而，这个求解器并不完美，它绝对不能替代合适的装备。您无需做任何操作即可启用此行为，只需启用Artisan即可。

如果您尝试制作默认求解器无法完成的制作，Artisan允许您构建宏，这些宏可以用作建议，而不是默认求解器。Artisan宏的好处是不受长度限制，可以以游戏允许的最快速度触发，并且还允许一些额外的选项进行即时调整。

entries.Original: Click here to be taken to the Macro menu.

Once you have created a macro, you will have to assign it to a recipe. This is easily accomplished by using the Recipe Window dropdown. By default, this is attached to the top right of the in-game crafting log window but can be unattached in the settings.
entries.Translated: 创建宏后，您需要将其分配给配方。这可以通过配方窗口下拉菜单轻松完成。默认情况下，它附加在游戏内制作日志窗口的右上角，但可以在设置中取消附加。

entries.Original: Select a macro you have created from the dropdown box. When you go to craft this item, the suggestions will be replaced by the contents of your macro.
entries.Translated: 从下拉框中选择您创建的宏。当您制作此物品时，建议将被宏的内容替换。

entries.Original:
Artisan has a mode titled "Endurance Mode" which is basically a fancier way of saying "Auto-repeat mode" which will continually try to craft the same item for you. Endurance Mode works by selecting a recipe from the in-game crafting log and enabling the feature. Your character will then attempt to keep crafting that item as many times as you have materials for it. 

The other features should hopefully be self-explanatory as Endurance Mode can also manage the usage of your food, potions, manuals, repairs and materia extraction between crafts. The repair feature only supports repairing with dark matter and does not support repair NPCs.
entries.Translated:
Artisan有一个名为“耐力模式”的模式，基本上就是“自动重复模式”的另一种说法，它会持续尝试为您制作同一物品。耐力模式通过从游戏内制作日志中选择配方并启用该功能来工作。然后，您的角色将尝试继续制作该物品，次数取决于您拥有的材料数量。

其他功能应该不言自明，因为耐力模式还可以管理您在制作之间使用食物、药水、手册、修理和精制魔晶石。修理功能仅支持使用暗物质进行修理，不支持修理NPC。

entries.Original: Artisan also has the ability to create a list of items and have it start crafting each of them, one after another, automatically. Crafting lists have a lot of powerful tools to streamline the process of going from materials to final products. It also supports importing and exporting to Teamcraft.
entries.Translated: Artisan还能够创建物品列表，并自动开始逐一制作每个物品。制作列表具有许多强大的工具，可以简化从材料到最终产品的过程。它还支持导入和导出到Teamcraft。

entries.Original: Crafting lists are a fantastic way to queue up different crafts and have them craft one-by-one. Create a list by importing from Teamcraft using the button at the bottom, or click the '+' icon and give your list a name.
entries.Translated: 制作列表是一种很棒的方式，可以排队不同的制作并逐个制作。通过底部的按钮从 Teamcraft 导入列表，或点击“+”图标并为列表命名。

entries.Original: You can also right click an item from the game's recipe menu to either add it to a new list if one is not selected, or to create a new list with it as the first item if a list is not selected.
entries.Translated: 您也可以右键点击游戏配方菜单中的物品，将其添加到新列表（如果未选择列表），或创建以该物品为首项的新列表（如果未选择列表）。

entries.Original: Left click a list to open the editor. Right click a list to select it without opening the editor.
entries.Translated: 左键点击列表打开编辑器。右键点击列表选择它而不打开编辑器。

entries.Original: This section is for building lists based on certain criteria rather than individually. Give your list a name and select your criteria from below then select "Build List" and a new list will be created with all items that match the criteria. If you do not select any checkboxes then that category will be treated as "Any" or "All" except for which job crafts it.
entries.Translated: 此部分用于按特定条件而非逐个构建列表。为列表命名并选择下方条件，然后点击“构建列表”，将创建包含所有匹配条件物品的新列表。若未勾选任何复选框，则该类别视为“任意”或“全部”，但制作职业除外。

entries.Original: Please give your list a name.

Guide to importing lists.

Step 1. Open a list on Teamcraft with the items you wish to craft.

Step 2. Find the pre crafts section and click the "Copy as Text" button.

Step 3. Paste into the Pre-Craft Items box in this window.

Step 4. Repeat Step 2 & 3 but for the final items section.

Step 5. Give your list a name and click import.
entries.Translated:
导入列表指南。

步骤1：在Teamcraft上打开包含要制作物品的列表。

步骤2：找到半成品部分，点击“复制为文本”按钮。

步骤3：粘贴到此窗口的“半成品物品”框中。

步骤4：重复步骤2和3，但针对最终物品部分。

步骤5：为列表命名并点击导入。

entries.Original: These items will try to be added as quick synth due to the default setting being enabled.
entries.Translated: 由于默认设置已启用，这些物品将尝试作为快速制作添加。

entries.Original: The imported list has no items. Please check your import and try again.

entries.Original: Endurance mode is Artisan's way to repeat the same craft over and over, either so many times or until you run out of materials. It has full capabilities to automatically repair your gear once a piece is under a certain percentage, use food/potions/exp manuals and extract materia from spiritbonding. Please note these settings are independent of crafting list settings, and only intended to be used to craft the one item repeatedly.
entries.Translated: 耐力模式是工匠重复制作同一件物品的方式，可以设定次数或直到材料耗尽。它具备自动修理装备（当部件耐久低于一定百分比时）、使用食物/药水/经验手册以及从魂晶中提取魔晶石的功能。请注意，这些设置独立于制作列表设置，仅用于重复制作单一物品。

entries.Original: You cannot start Endurance as you do not possess ingredients to craft this recipe.
entries.Translated: 您无法开始耐力模式，因为您没有制作此配方所需的材料。

entries.Original:
In order to begin Endurance Mode crafting you should first select the recipe in the crafting menu.
Endurance Mode will automatically repeat the selected recipe similar to Auto-Craft but will factor in food/medicine buffs before doing so.
entries.Translated:
要开始耐力模式制作，你应先在制作菜单中选择配方。
耐力模式会自动重复所选配方，类似于自动制作，但在此之前会因子还原食物/药品增益。
